_comment: Design v3 §5.2. The ETF sleeve, maintained by hand because it changes on the order of once a decade — a refresh cadence would be ceremony. `sector` is the MACRO rotation set (§6.4) and is the §5.3 '≤ 11' bound; `broad` names are universe members reachable only by a play trigger, never by rotation.
_values_are: The concentration bucket the symbol counts against, not a label. Sector SPDRs carry the GICS names the SSGA holdings file publishes, so XLE and XOM share one Energy cap without a translation table. The broad four share a single bucket because SPY, QQQ, IWM and DIA are close enough to the same bet that giving each its own cap headroom would be a fiction.
_source: https://www.sectorspdrs.com — State Street sector SPDR family
